native_cases.name: allow_real_registry_read
native_cases.stimulus: Real Hermes registry dispatch through the product extension
native_cases.expected: one matching file.read and file.disclose ALLOW; durable audit before read and release

native_cases.name: direct_protected_file_open
native_cases.stimulus: Actual child attempts read/write opens on host document/policy/audit/config outside bridge
native_cases.expected: all opens denied; descriptors verified; no canary returned

native_cases.name: policy_deny
native_cases.stimulus: Raw framed request; current host policy denies exact file.read

native_cases.name: wrong_resource
native_cases.stimulus: Raw framed request for a different resource ID

native_cases.name: claimed_actor_field
native_cases.stimulus: Add actor_id to otherwise valid request
native_cases.expected: unknown-field denial; host identity is not replaced

native_cases.name: replay_consumed_admission
native_cases.stimulus: Reuse N01 consumed token with the current next channel sequence; independently test byte-identical request replay in local L02
native_cases.expected: deny replay; revoke current lease too; no cached document resend

native_cases.name: expired_lease
native_cases.stimulus: Wait beyond actual host monotonic TTL before submission
native_cases.expected: deny expiry without fake native clock

native_cases.name: cancel_before_admission
native_cases.stimulus: Host revokes fresh lease before child's request is admitted

native_cases.name: audit_failure_before_read
native_cases.stimulus: Fixed test-profile writer fault on read-intent append/flush path
native_cases.expected: fail closed; no file read; independently count zero release

native_cases.name: disclosure_policy_deny
native_cases.stimulus: Authorize/read synthetic file; deny separate file.disclose
native_cases.expected: bounded read is recorded, no document bytes released

native_cases.name: audit_failure_before_release
native_cases.stimulus: Authorize/read; fixed test-profile writer fault at release-intent durability
native_cases.expected: read is recorded, zero document bytes released; uncertain audit flagged

native_cases.name: unsupported_operation
native_cases.stimulus: Raw framed file-write or generic execution operation

local_required_cases.name: framing
local_required_cases.stimulus: Partial headers/body, invalid UTF-8/BOM, duplicate keys, NaN, trailing JSON, depth 9 and zero/8193 length
local_required_cases.expected: reject before allocation/effect; terminal channel on framing faults

local_required_cases.name: schema_and_limits
local_required_cases.stimulus: Extra fields, bool/float seq, wrong versions/attempt, malformed token, 17th request, cumulative limit
local_required_cases.expected: strict denial or terminal bounded overflow; no release

local_required_cases.name: identity_and_channel
local_required_cases.stimulus: Wrong child binding, worker reply request-ID mismatch, crossed worker/child handles

local_required_cases.name: audit_durability
local_required_cases.stimulus: Read/release audit append, flush, fsync failures and audit size overflow

local_required_cases.name: decision_types
local_required_cases.stimulus: Every non-ALLOW decision, ALLOW with constraints/redactions, policy exceptions or invalid result

local_required_cases.name: revocation_races
local_required_cases.stimulus: Deterministic cancellation/expiry before read, before release commit and after commit
local_required_cases.expected: zero release before commit; after commit accurately committed/sent/uncertain, never pretend recall

local_required_cases.name: disconnects_and_deadlines
local_required_cases.stimulus: Worker crash/EOF/hang, child EOF mid-frame, blocked pipe, partial response send
local_required_cases.expected: revoke, deadline stop, no retransmit/fallback; preserve uncertain outcome

local_required_cases.name: protected_paths
local_required_cases.stimulus: Reparse/link/path substitution, host file replacement, wrong DACL/inherited broad grant, oversize document
local_required_cases.expected: block before release; no arbitrary-file resolution

local_required_cases.name: hermes_interface
local_required_cases.stimulus: AST-bound native registry signatures, duplicate registration, wrong handler/schema/toolset, dispatch error JSON
local_required_cases.expected: reject fake/partial tool integration; error JSON is not success

local_required_cases.name: lifecycle_and_evidence
local_required_cases.stimulus: Failed worker token/job/readiness, coordinator crash model, stderr overflow, missing/forged child evidence
local_required_cases.expected: no child resume where preflight fails; fail closed and honest cleanup state

local_required_cases.name: secret_safe_reporting
local_required_cases.stimulus: Token/canary/error text supplied as diagnostics or reflected fields
local_required_cases.expected: no raw secret/document/exception in public report

local_required_cases.name: disclosure_validation
local_required_cases.stimulus: Unexpected worker content/schema/length/digest or unsupported recipient

fault_injection.N09: fixed compile-profile host-owned audit writer fault, not actual disk-failure qualification
fault_injection.N11: fixed compile-profile host-owned release audit durability fault, not actual disk-failure qualification

evidence.authoritative: trusted coordinator/worker actual event order and effect/channel counters
evidence.canary: host-generated 256-bit unpredictable value; not preseeded or published
evidence.public_data: fixed codes/counts/digests, never admission tokens/document bytes
evidence.direct_denial: actual child read/write failures plus verified descriptors

stop: first unexpected/missing/inconclusive result aborts remaining cases, revokes and cleans up; no retry
